title: Run event
description: Kernel-emitted lifecycle events for a specific run. Streamed over SSE to subscribers (browser via client SDK, admin UI, external observers). Distinct from the general Event type: RunEvents are always about a specific run, always emitted by the kernel, and are used by the run subscription API rather than the general subscription API.

eventId.description: `<runId>:<sequence>`; monotonic within the run. Used as `Last-Event-Id` for SSE resumability.

sequence.description: Monotonic sequence within the run: the journal entry's `sequence` (`JournalEntry.sequence` in `@kindgi/runtime`).

nodeId.description: For step-scoped events: the flow node id.

payload.description: Kind-specific payload. Model tokens carry text; guardrail-violated carries the guardrail id and evidence; approval-requested carries the token id and prompt; etc.
